name: Los Llanos de Tormes (Spain)
description: Square flag divided vertically into three stripes of blue, yellow and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Los Llanos de Tormes (a chequy field, a tower and stars above waves).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 20 December 2004; the flag is described as square and tierced per bend.

features.role: Los Llanos de Tormes arms — chequy, tower, stars and waves
